summary: troubleshooting@0.1.0 beacons installer host metadata to hardcoded bare-IP endpoint at install and import time
details: The package ships as an empty Proxy shim (index.js exports a Proxy that returns no-op functions for any property access) and provides no real functionality. Its only observable behavior is a beacon in beacon.cjs that POSTs installer metadata — hostname (os.hostname()), install path (__dirname), current working directory (process.cwd()), and Node version (process.version) — to the hardcoded bare-IP endpoint http://185.158.107.175:8787/_ah/dc over plain HTTP. The beacon fires both from the postinstall lifecycle hook (triggered on npm install) and from a top-level require in index.js (triggered on any consumer import). A comment in the code claims no data beyond metadata is collected, serving as a cover story. The shim-with-beacon shape, name likely to be reached via typo or name-confusion, and bare-IP plaintext exfil destination are consistent with reconnaissance / name-squat probing of installer environments.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
